tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/password-hashing.md <<'EOF'
# Password Hashing

No password hashing algorithm is currently recorded as a project decision. Until one is decided and recorded, this policy does not specify an algorithm, and none should be assumed.
EOF
cat docs/policies/password-hashing.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/password-hashing.md`. It says that no password hashing algorithm is currently recorded as a project decision, and that none should be assumed.

I wrote that because Muninn has no decision or rule on password hashing. Its catalog lists only four decisions (https everywhere, verification on all builds, rustls, and an LRU cache with a 300-second TTL). `muninn why` said it was insufficient, since nothing of trust 2 or higher answers the question.

The only related material is two unpromoted, trust-1 session excerpts that conflict with each other. Neither was recorded as a decision, so I left both out of the file.

If you want a specific algorithm written into the policy, tell me which one. I'll update the file once you confirm it as the decision.
